// diagnostic

E0411

`pub` on a declaration or field was removed; everything is public by default (D-VIS-MODULE1)

What

`pub` on a declaration or field was removed; everything is public by default (D-VIS-MODULE1)

Why

Jet declarations are public by default; only `pub use` re-exports keep `pub` until the re-export ballot

Fix

Delete the `pub` / `pub(…)` marker.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0411: tests/ui/vis_pub_removed.stderr.

Error [E0411]: `pub` was removed: everything is public by default
  --> tests/ui/vis_pub_removed.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | pub fn greet() -> String { "hi" }
    | ^^^
 Why: Privacy belongs to a `priv module` (or `priv(package) module`) and to `priv` fields
 Fix: Delete `pub`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0411
